import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Age distribution
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax1, color='skyblue')
ax1.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Age')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')

# 2. Sleep Duration by Gender
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', ax=ax2, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')

# 3. Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', ax=ax3, 
            order=bmi_present, palette='Set3')
ax3.set_title('Quality of Sleep by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Physical Activity Level vs Sleep Duration
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Sleep Duration', 
                hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=100, ax=ax4, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Duration', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')

# 5. Stress Level vs Quality of Sleep
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', s=100, ax=ax5, alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_title('Stress Level vs Quality of Sleep', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax5.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')

# 6. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('pastel')[0:len(disorder_counts)]
ax6.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
occupation_data = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
sns.barplot(x=occupation_data.values, y=occupation_data.index, ax=ax7, palette='viridis')
ax7.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps')
ax7.set_ylabel('Occupation')

# 8. Heart Rate vs Age
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Age', y='Heart Rate', hue='Gender', 
                size='Stress Level', sizes=(50, 200), ax=ax8, alpha=0.6)
ax8.set_title('Heart Rate vs Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Age')
ax8.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')

# 9. Correlation heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax9.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
